correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly treats arbitrary valuations by reducing each modal scope to a function W->[0,1]. At zero-weight worlds Gödel implication is one, while diamond minimum is zero. Finite positive support makes box infima minima. Infinite positive support yields a strictly positive atomic residual sequence converging to unattained zero. Finite positive superlevel sets make every positive diamond supremum the maximum over one finite level; zero suprema are automatically attained since W is nonempty. An infinite positive level permits an increasing atomic diamond sequence converging to an unattained positive limit. The constructions are valid at depth one and for any cardinality in ordinary set theory with choice. Exact finite checks (4,368 cases plus twelve prefixes) were replayed from verify.py and are explicitly non-proofs for infinite claims.

originality.rationale: The 2026 main source establishes witnessed model semantics and an infinite counterexample, not the pair of operator-selective universal-frame equivalences. The 2025 crisp model paper and 2022 paraconsistent Gödel frame-definability result cover related finite-branching phenomena, but no inspected full-text theorem implies the separate positive-level-set criterion on arbitrary fuzzy rows. The two clauses were compared as implications: finite support implies c0 but c0 does not imply finite support. Targeted mathematical-literature and published-record searches found no complete equivalence; residual older terminology risk remains.
residual_risks: A prior theorem about extrema of weighted fuzzy modal operators, presented as compactness or order-theoretic attainment rather than modal witnessing, could imply these statements.
The box/finiteness direction is close to known finite-branching frame folklore; particular nonattainment examples and syntactic frame definability are established prior results, not claimed as new.

value.rationale: The question is natural in witnessed Gödel modal semantics: fixed valuations can happen to be witnessed even on problematic frames, but when does the frame alone guarantee witnesses? The exact duality between finite positive support for necessity and c0 decay of positive accessibility levels for possibility is a complete structural classification, not an arbitrary finite slice. The explicit infinite weighted example proves the classes are different, giving a meaningful choice of models whose possibility values are guaranteed attained without imposing finite branching. No unsupported complexity or axiomatization consequences are asserted.
